turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm tweaking the evaluation script. Right now, the objective scores are just integers {0, 1, 2}. It feels too coarse.
Got it. Integer steps can be limiting for fine-grained ranking. Did you consider floats?
Maybe, but for now let's stick to the integer logic. Oh, also, did that hardware order for the new SSD arrive?
The tracking number was 1Z999... it shows as out for delivery today.
Nice. I'll keep the {0, 1, 2} setup for this run.
Understood. I'll note that the current objective layer uses integer scores.
Thanks. Also, is it going to rain tomorrow?
Looks like a 40% chance of showers in the afternoon.
Lloyd, quick update on the eval pipeline. We've overhauled the objective layer.
We moved away from integers. Objective scores are restricted to the set {0.0, 0.5, 1.0} now.
That allows for partial credit without being too noisy. Noted.
Exactly. By the way, did you check if the SSD installation guide is online?
I can look that up for you after we finish this chat.
Cool. Just remember the new score set for future references.
